extra_quotes: The simulations of reflectance spectra and electric field distribution were carried out using the Finite-Difference Time Domain (FDTD) Solutions, ANSYS Inc. software.

Current–voltage and transient photocurrent measurements were performed using a computer-controlled dual-channel source meter (Keysight B2912A), which was used to apply the electrical bias and record the device current.
The MIR-induced spectral redistribution was characterized separately on a transmissive substrate because the Al/p-Si device does not support the required MIR transmission geometry.
